tei:titleStmt.tei:title: klong snying thugs rje chen po'i sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i stongag thun dri za'i rgyun mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal kun brtse ba chen po rtags ka
klong snying thugs rje chen po'i sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i stongag thun dri za'i rgyun mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal kun brtse ba chen po rtags ka

tei:div.tei:p: klong snying thugs rje chen po'i sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i stongag thun dri za'i rgyun mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal kun brtse ba chen po rtags kyi lhar// yongs bzhengs thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam par 'char ba'i dpyid// sdug bsngal rang grol lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi sgrub chen tshogs kyi tshom bu ru// 'jug pa'i sgrub khog lam gyi snang ba la// stong thun mtshams sbyor rin chen za ma tog /rnam par dbye ba cung zad 'dir 'god bya// de'ang thog mar ma tram̐ bsgral chog gong*/ rdo rje rgyal tshab kyis 'di skad du/ kyai/ skal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las su rung zhing gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gnyan por 'du bar 'os pa rdo rje'i mched dang lcam dral rnams tshom bu tshogs su sgrub 'i phrin las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa'i thog mar/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang ba'i zhal nas/ phyi nang gsang ba bsrung bya ba// srin po'i rgyal po tshul bzhin mnan// ces gsungs pas sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar dang mthun par rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len du sbyar nas ma tram̐ bsgral mnan gyi cho ga bgyid pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de la lhan skyes don gyi ru tra ni/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ bgegs kyi bgegs ste bgegs chen po// dug lnga'i rtog pa nyid las skye// phyed dang gsum gyi dur khrod na// gzhi rtsa ngag dang lus sems so// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

las snang ba/ ngag phyed snang*/ yid mi snang bas bsdus pa'i srid pa khams kyi dur khrod chen po la dbang byed pa ste/ mdo le'u nyer bdun pa las/ rgyu dang rkyen dang ma rig pas// phyi nang rten 'brel gnyis su 'khor// zhes pa bzhin/ rtsa ba de kho na nyid dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems ma rig pa/ phyi gzung 'dzin las skyes pa'i rtsal dug lnga bdag rtog gi rū tra chen po'i 'khor du nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong ldang 'dug gi tshul du khrid pa ni bsgral bya/ dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med du rtogs pa'i lta bas drang ba'i lha rtog dbyer med kyis lam bskyed rdzogs kyi bsdus pa ye shes khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa sgrol byed/ thabs de la brten nas gsang ba chen po chos nyid kyi dbyings su bsgral zhing rtsad nas gcod pa ni sgrol ba'i tshul te/ snga ma las/ ma rig mun khang sgo phyes te// glang chen smyon pa de brdung te// gzung 'dzin dam pa'i rtog thag bcad// dug gsum rnam rtog rtod phur phyung*// ngan song 'dam nas drangs nas ni// nyon mongs dpung rgod de btul nas// ye shes thabs kyis rnam par sbyang*// zhes so// mtshan ma brda yi ru tra ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus dpag tu med pa nas/ bskal pa kun tu dga' bar sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i bstan pa la dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu'i slob ma thar pa nag po zhes bya bas slob dpon gyis bstan pa'i gab pa'i gsang ba gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi ltabar ma rtogs par sbas pa'i gsang ba sbyor sgrol rlang por spyod pa las/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bus dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong zhing lha rang rgyud par bsgom zhing drag sngags rang gar bzlas pa'i 'bras bu yi dwags kyi 'gro bas bsdus pa'i srin mo bya yi gshog pa can du skye ba bzung nas gzugs khams gnas ris bcu gnyis man chad dbang du byas shing gdug pa can mtha' dag bran du bskol ba'i dbang phyug chen po bsgral 'os kyi las dang skal bar ldan pa de nyid/

sngon gyi dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad tshad med pa'i thugs rje skyes te/ ru tra'i 'dod chags bzhi la dgongs pa'irgyud sde bzhi/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad la dgongs pa'i sgrub chen bka' brgyad/ nyon mongs pa lnga la dgongs pa'i rigs lnga'i he ru ka gdul bya rtsa ba'i dngos po smin pa'i phyir/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sprul nas/ khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs dang*/ ltas chen po bco lnga spros te sgrol byed cho 'phrul chen po 'du mdzad pas gdug pa can mtha' dag 'dun pa sems pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa la bkod/ rnam smin dang tshe dbang la sogs 'i sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin sha stag tu smin par mdzad/ sku gsung thugs che ba'i yon tan gyis sgrol ba'i tshul sngags kyi gleng gzhir smos pas mtshon par bya ba dang*/ btags pa'i ming gi ru tra ni/ he ru ka snying rje rol pa'i rgyud las/ sku gsum 'gro ba'i tshul ston pas// dus la bab pa'i sems can dbang*// las la bab pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du// thugs rje'i lcags kyus bkug nas su// yang dag nyid la yang dag sgrol// yang dag bsgral nas bde chen thob// mi ldog pa la nges par phyin// phyin pa tsam gyis bde chen thob// rgyal ba'i zhing khams dbyings nyid mthong*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi gnas rang byung gi rang ngo ma rig par khams gsum du 'khyams pa'i dug gsum gyi rang gzugs mtshan rtog gis bcing ba'i gdug can 'byung po'i dbang phyug gi gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir bkod pa/ bsgral bya/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po dbyer med pa phyag rgya gcig pa dang*/ phyag rgya spros bcas kyi ye shes nar son te gnyis snang mtha' dag gnyis med ye shes kyi dbang du bsgyur ba dpal chen rdo rje srin po'i ting 'dzin las mi g.yo ba sgrol byed gnyen po ste/

kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ dur khrod chen po bzhi'i phyogs ni// mgo bo lho nub mtshams su bstan// rkang pa byang shar mtshams su gtad// ces dang*/ snying rje rol pa'i rgyud las/ gnas 'di'i sgo 'di su yis bcad// sems kyi bdag por bcad dam ci// gzung 'dzin rkang lag bsnol ba'i sgo// yul las 'das pa'i zhabs kyis dbye// zhes rdo rje tshig gis bstan pa'i don rnams sngar gyi slob dpon grub pa brnyes pa'i phyag bzhes su byung ba rgyud kyi dngos po bcu'i rim pa ma nor ba'i sgo nas bdag nyid chen po lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul lag tu len na khams gsum gyi 'byung po bdag po dbang phyug chen po bsgral bas de'i bran du gyur pa'i bgegs rigs rnams kyis sgrub pa la 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor rang shugs su zhi ba dang*/ khog pa dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis rlabs pa la ḍāk+ki dam can rang bzhin gyis 'du ba dang*/ de'i nus pas bar chad zhi zhing dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag tu thob pa dang*/ gang gi rtsa mdud grol zhing gsang ba'i 'og min du bdud bzhi bcom nas mngon byang lnga yi 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrigs pa ni bsgral ba'i dgos pa ste/ de lta bu'i las rim la 'jug pa na/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/ srid gsum gdug cing gtum pa la// zhi bas phan pa mi 'gyur te// shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ khro bo de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad// ces pa ltar/ chos nyid/ rang bzhin/ ye shes dang*/ thugs rje shugs kyis khro bo'i mdzad pa'i phrin las kyang 'dul thabs kyi khro bor bcos pa ste/ de'ang rgyud las/ khro bo'i tshul can khros pa yi// 'jig rten gsum dag bsregs byed na// sangs rgyas thugs rje khros pa yi/ khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lta ba gyab kyi lha de bzhin nyid kyi ngang las/ gnyen po ting nge 'dzin gyi lha dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bsgral ba'i las rim la 'jug par zhu/

zhes so/ sgrub pa po rnams mnga' gsol zhing gnas su dgod pa'i skabs su rdo rje rgyal thebs zhwa chos bcas g.yas gral gsham du bzhengs te/ deng bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan rab tu 'char ba'i dus kyi char/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol gyi sgrub chen myong grol skye bdun ril bu'i sgrub pa dang sbrel mar bgyid pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de yang*/ gsang rab yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud las/ rgyud don gsang ba'i sgrub chen la// bzhi ste phun sum tshogs bzhi gsungs// sta gon rim pa'i snod du gzhugs// dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrang ste// mtha' rgyas cho ga rjes skyong ngo*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung*/ sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pas sgrub pa'i sgrom du gzhug bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang*/ las mtha' rgyas kyi rim pas sgrub pa'i rjes bskyang bar byas pa las/ de yang gnas phun su tshogs pa ni/ spyir bskal bzang sgron me stong phrag gcig gis dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i zhing khams 'di 'dzam bu gling gi nang tshan yul chen nyer bzhi'i ya gyal bod yul kha ba can gyi yul ljongs 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i gdul ba'i zhing khams/ bye brag bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa rong chen kha ba dkar po'i sa yi thig le de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla mas bsrung ba'i gangs ri seng ge gnam rdzogs/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du mas brgyan pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ ye shes rngam pa klog gi mdo las/ rig byed dag gi yan lag las// dus rnams shes par bya ba ni// bkra shis lha yi nyi ma dang*// 'byor dang dus tshod bzang ba ni// mtshan ma'i rtog pa yin mod kyang*// brtags na dngos grub mtshan ma byung*// zhes pa ltar/

spyir gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dang*/ dus tshod mi mthun pa dang bral bas dge zhing shis la/ zla ba dang po la mtshon na khyad par du bdag cag gi ston pas/ rgya gar gnyan yod kyi grong khyer du mu stegs ston pa sde drug la sogs pa/ cho 'phrul chen pos btul ba'i dus chen/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma ka ras/ gdul bya gzhan snang du slob dpon kun dga' bo las rab tu byung zhing sde snod gsum gyi gdams pa gsan cing ston pa'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol zhing mtshan shākya seng ger grags pa'i dus phun sum tshogs pa la/ yang na zla ba gsum pa mtshon na khyad par bdag cag gi ston pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyal chen po rnams gsungs shing*/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma kā ra slob dpon chen po pra bha ha sti'i spyan sngar rnal 'byor yo ga'i gdams pa gsan cing mtshan blo ldan mchog sred du grags pa'i dus/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa sgyu 'phrul lam rim las/ gos rgyan bza' btung gsang ba dang*// sgrub pa'i yo byad lnga rnams dang*// dkyil 'khor yo byad mchod pa'i rdzas// dngos grub rten dang bar chad bzlog /yo byad dag par bsdu bya ste// zhes pa ltar/ 'tsho ba zas dang*/ rkyen zlog sman/ sgrub pa rdzas/ mchod pa'i yo byad spyi dang bye brag ma tshang ba med pa/ sgrub pa po ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ lam rim las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs// gnyer ldan rgyud ldan las la mkhas// man ngag drod 'dzin brgyad 'chang ba// rnal 'byor mtha' ldan shin tu brten// zhes lta ba ting nge 'dzin spyod pa'i mdzod yo ga gsum la mkhas pa'i don dang ldan zhing phan nus zab mo'i dbang gi chu bo rdzogs pa/ gsang ba'i gnyer thub cing rgyud kyi dngos po bcu la mkhas pa/ sgrub pa'i lam rim la ma rmongs shing man ngag nyams myong dang ldan pa/

'khor yang rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po las/ ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal// dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams// ma nyams shes shing yo byad ldan// zhes pa'i don dang ldan cing*/ snod kyi skyon gsum bral la yon tan lnga pos rgyud phyug pa/ sgrub pa'i thabs phun sum tshogs pa sngags gsar ma ba las che ba drug gis 'phags pa snga 'gyur rnying ma/ bka' gter gnyis las zab mo gter gyi phyogs la phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gter kha chen po lnga dang*/ de la'ang bla gter nyer lnga la sogs pa'i bye ba bco brgyad mchis pa las/ 'dir ni shar gter 'bras bu lta bu zhi ba rig 'dzin thugs kyi gter rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le las gsang sgrub thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol ste dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ lho phyogs 'od zer ming can sprul pa'i sku// zab don snying thig chos kyi 'gro ba 'dren// 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'phen pa 'byung*// zhes dang*/ rang gter las/ bī ma rgyal sras lha rje yi// thugs bskyed smon lam gcig bsdus pa// rang byung gdengs dang ldan pa'i bu// rtogs grol dus mnyam 'jigs med gling*// rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i rtags// tshems la yi ge a yis mtshan// dbang chen gsung gi rig pa 'dzin// mthe bong yi ge h+yas mtshan// zhes dang*/ yang*/ 'di ltar shin tu zab pa'i gnad// 'phags mchog sdug bsngal rang grol gyi// sgrub thabs rje btsun ma hā gu rus// mnga' bdag chos rgyal yab sras la// bar khang g.yu zhal 'bar ba ru// gdams te snying mdzod sgrom bud bstsal// smon lam gad rgya'i mthu btsan pos// da dus sa pho stag gi lor// thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong zhing*// ye shes dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki mas// 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'iklong*// klong gsal brda ris shog dril sprod// zhes pa bzhin/ bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi shar phyogs kyi khyams su ye shes kyis mkha' 'gro mas dngos su bstsal ba'i thugs rje chen po 'brel tshad don ldan gyi chos skor/

de nyid las/ de yang mchog sgrub myong grol rdzas// zos tshad 'phags pa'i thugs rje yis// rjes bzung las ngan srab nas kyang*// zhing mchog po ta la ru skye// zhes bsngags pa don dang ldan pa nyid/ gsang snying las/ gnas dang longs spyod ci bde dang*// ma nyams blo ni rab ldan pas// dang por dam mnos bzhin du bya// le lo sgyid snyoms med pa yis// gya tshom med par bsgrub byas na// dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// rdo rje gsang mchod dam pa zhes// ces pa la sogs pa ji skad gsungs pa legs par tshogs te sgrub pa'i las rim la 'jug pa na brgyud pa dgu yi bka' babs 'dzin cing yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon nyid 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mgon du bzhugs te g.yo med dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs par bzhugs/ de dang dgongs pa mnyam zhing dkyil 'khor gyi las rab 'byams sgrub par nus pa'i rdo rje'i rgyal tshab/ las bzhi lta spyod phrin las la dbang ba'i rigs bzhi'i rgyal thebs/ tan gan gyi sgyu rtsal la dkyil 'khor rab 'byams sgrub par nus pa'i rigs lnga'i gzungs ma/ cho ga bya ba mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i dpa' bo rgyal tshab/ mig rnon gyis mi ma yin mthong zlog nus pa'i rdo rje'i spyan pa/ dus drug thun tshod bzung ba'i rdo rje'i drod 'dzin mchod pa'i las khrigs la mkhas pa'i dza gad phud bdag phyi nang gi bar chad srung ba'i rdo rje mtshams pa/ dam sri nyul le skrod gzir dbang ba'i ging chen bzhi/ zhal zas las kyi bya ba la mkhas pa'i rdo rje byan pa pho mo/ mched lcam gyi dgongs pa skong ba'i rdo rje rdul phyag la sogs pa tshom bu sbrel zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba la brtson pa'i rdo rje mched lcam thams cad rigs dang go rim mthun pa'i gral la bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi gnyer du 'os pa'i sta dgongs phrin las la g.yel ba med par bka' gsang gnyan po'i gzhung dang mthun par khur du bzhes pa'i dgongs pa dang*/

dad mos brtse gdung mi 'bral pa'i ngang nas rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ ces so/ ༈ de nas mthar rgyas par mar me smon lam bya ba'i skabs su babs pa na/ rgyal thebs kyi gtso bos zhwa chos bcas gral gsham du bzhengs te/ 'o 'di ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung*/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis gzhung bsrangs te tshom bu tshogs kyis sgrub pa'i bya ba bar chad med par mthar phyin pas/ mos ldan spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir du 'bras bu rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i dus kyang cung zad brjod na/ spyir rgyu yi theg pa las khyad du mas 'phags pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa la rtogs bya gzhi'i rgyud/ rtogs byed lam gyi rgyud/ mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rgyud bcas gsum gyis bsdus shing*/ lam thabs kyi rgyud la dbye ba mtha' yas kyang*/ khyad par gyi dbang du byas te thabs kyi nges pa'i lam dang*/ shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba'i lam gnyis/ grol lam la'ang*/ cig char ba/ rim gyis pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po las/ shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor ba'i gzugs// 'bras bu smin byed rgyud dang rkyen// nus mthu can du gang gyur pa// rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba gtan la phebs nas/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting 'dzin la mos sgom dang nges rdzogs kyi tshul gnyis las/ skabs 'dir mos sgom tsam gyis tshom bur 'dus pa'i sgo nas spros bcas bskyed rim dang phyogs mthun du bsgrubs 'bras bu 'ang*/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma dang*/ skal pa bzang ngan/ dad brtson sogs kyi rim pa ltar skye ba 'di 'am/ bar do 'am/ yang mtha' skye ba bdun tshun chad nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur te/ gu ru rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgrub chen 'di lta bu rab lo sgrub/ 'bring zla sgrub/ tha ma zhag sgrub tsam byas na yang sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa byang zhing sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*/

mchog thun mong gi dngos grub sna re thob pa gdon mi za/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang mdo sde za ma tog las/ yi ge drug pa la slob pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa bdun 'du bar 'gyur ro// byang chub sems dpa' rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa 'du bar 'gyur ro// rgyal po chen po bzhi yis phyogs bzhi bsrung bar 'gyur ro// klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis 'og bsrung bar 'gyur ro// gnod sbyin rnams kyis steng bsrung bar 'gyur ro// ba spu'i rtsa ba re re na yang sangs rgyas bye ba bzhugs nas legs so legs so zhes bya ba gsung bar 'gyur ro// ting nge 'dzin brgya rtsa thob par 'gyur ro// pha rol du phyin pa drug rdzogs par 'gyur ro// myur du mngaun par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ sogs gsungs pa dang*/ yi ge drug ma 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung ba yin pas 'di zlos cig 'di la nan tan bskyed cig ces dang*/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i zhal nas/ thugs rje yi ge drug ma 'dis/ thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs 'grub par byed do// de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs 'grub par byed pa'i rig sngags yin no// sdig sgrib thams cad zad cing nad dang gnod pa gdon dang bar chad thams cad sel bar byed pa'i gzungs sngags yin no// tshe 'di la lus ngag yid gsum ma spangs gnas su dag nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs lhun gyis grub par byed pa'i gsang sngags yin no// rdo rje snying po yi ge drug ma 'di/ gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags gsum gyi rtsa ba yin pas/ 'di ni bzlas pa tsam gyis dngos grub 'grub par byed pas rgyun du bgrongs shig klog shig sgrogs shig ces so// de yang lan gcig ma yin par yang yang bsgrub na shin tu bskal pa dman pas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas te/

byang gter las/ lan gsum bsgrub na dngos grub rnam gnyis thob// rig 'dzin gral la the tshom yod re kan// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar tshul bzhin sgrub pa la zhugs nas 'bras bu 'grub pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ sgrub chen 'di lta bu la bzang ngan gyi 'brel pa cung zad thogs pa rnams kyang byang chub kyi sa bon thebs par 'gyur te/ de nyid las/ dad ldan snod ldan gang zag la// rtse gcig bsgom pa'i skabs med na// mthong ngam thos sam reg pa yis// byang chub lam la bgrod pa'i thabs// 'di nyid yin no nyams su longs// zhes so// gsang sngags spyi las kyang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gter chos zab mo rnams byin rlabs dang 'gro don che bar gsungs te/ dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ ji srid sangs rgyas bstan pa ma rdzogs bar// de srid gter gyi 'gro ba dpag med 'dren// de phyir gter la dad dang gus par gyis// de yang drang don min gyi nges don yin// bla med theg chen snying po'i don rnams dang// gang 'brel thams cad sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phyir// 'dis grol 'dis ma grol ba'i rnam dbye bral// 'brel tshad don dang ldan zhes de la brjod// ces sogs lung mtha' yas pa 'byung ba dang*/ gter chos zab mo 'di rnams kyis dbang lung phyag len bsnyen bsgrub sogs gzhung dang mthun par rang gis bgyid cing gzhan la spel nus pa ni o rgyan nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa yin par lung gis bstan te/ de nyid las/ nga sprul gang 'brel ngan song skye sgo gcod// bka' shog 'dzin pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa// nga sprul bstan srung yin par shes par gyis// gang bab rgyud rnams 'brel tshad don ldan te// mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la// gzhung bzhi'i su dang su yis spyod pa kun// thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges// phyi rabs kun gyis yid gnyis the tshom spongs// gus pas bkur sti phu dud 'brel ba thogs// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

gter chos la mos shing dad pa skye ba rnams kyang sngon o rgyan chen po bod du phebs pa'i skabs su smon lam thebs pa'i las can yin pas na/ thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms/ kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser bas dkon ces gsungs so// de ltar las 'phro skal pa bzang po dang ldan pas gsang sngags gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'dus shing snang gsal gyi mar me la bltas pa ni/ de ltar shin tu 'dres pa'i mched du gyur pa yin pas/ phyin chad kyang slob dpon la yi dam dngos su 'du shes pa dang*/ mched lcam rnams gcig gis gcig la dag snang kho na sbyong ba la sogs pa/ bag yod dran shes dang ldan pa'i gsang ba'i dam tshig srog ltar bsrung zhing sgo gsum dkyil 'khor rnam gsum dang ma bral bar mdzad na/ skye ba 'di nyid la tshogs sbyor gyi lam bgrod de mtshan nyid gsum ldan pa'i rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin mngon du byed cing*/ rim gyis mthong sgom mi slob pa ste/ lam gyur gyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi mthar phyin pa/ 'bras dus kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga yi bdag nyid can gdod ma'i mgon po'i gsang ba lhun gyis grub te/ nam mkha' ji srid du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i rol mo mtha' klas pa 'char bar 'gyur ba/ de lta bu'i tshul rnams thugs la nges shing*/ spros pa chen po dang ldan par bsgrub pa'i mtha' rgyas kyi bye brag rten 'brel khyad par 'phags pa/ snang gsal mar me smon lam gdab pa'i skabs su babs pa ste/ de yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo las/ sgron ma'i snang ba mi shes pa// shes bya kun la mun pas bsgribs// nam yang snang bar mi 'gyur ste// long ba'i grong khyer chen par 'gro// sgron me 'bar ba gang bsrel ba// kun la mun pa sangs gsal ba'i// ma nor ma bcos de bzhin nyid// sgron ma dmigs bu'i mthong bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

mi shes mun pa sel zhing gnas lugs gzhi'i snang ba mtshon par byed pa ni sgron me'i ming du grags te/ de yang gsang ba'i bdag pos/ rin chen 'bar ba'i sgron ma bsrel ba'o// zhes brda'i sgo nas bstan pa ltar gzhi chos nyid kyi kong bur dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du bzhugs pa'i lha rtog dbyer med pa'i mar khus gtams te/ 'bras bu rang rig rang gsal gyi mar me 'bar ba brda'i sgron me 'dis mtshon byed du byas nas/ thos pa'i shes rab kyis lus can kun gyi snying khar bzhugs pa'i ye shes mtshon par byas te/ thag lta bas bcad/ nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis blangs/ la spyod pas dor te/ de kho na nyid kyi don la bsam pas nyams su myong ba nyid/ tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pas bogs dbyung nas mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam gyis ye shes mngon sum rtogs pa'i sgron ma rang chas su bzhugs pa mngon du gyur pa'i rim pa rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i spang byang rtsa ba dang rkyen gyis ma rig pa'i mun pa'i sgrib pa gnyis lhag ma med par bcom ste/ sa rnam par bkod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gi ye shes gong du 'phel ste/ rang gnas kyi sku dang zhing khams tshad med pa mtshan gzhi don gyi sgron ma 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo mngon du byas pas ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa de srid rtag khyab lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las rgya che zhing rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rten 'byung smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba la thugs 'dun rtse gcig pas rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ gang zhig lam 'dir cung zad 'brel ba ni// yid can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal phyir bsnyil ba// 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po sgrub pa'i thabs// spros bcas lam dang 'brel ba'i sgrub chen gyi// stong thun mtshams sbyar nyung ngu'i ngag tu bsdus// dge ba dung dang pad rtsa ltar dkar bas// lus can snying gi mun pa mthar byas te// mig mi 'dzum pa'i go 'phang mngon byas nas// 'brel tshad don ldan 'phags pa'i phrin las kyis// 'khor ba dong sprugs dge legs gru char gyis// sa gsum nang gi gdung ba rab zhi nas// dge legs dpal 'dis 'gro kun bsrung bar shog
